# opusdns_organization_ip_restriction (Data Source)

Reads a single organization IP restriction by id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opusdns_organization_ip_restriction" "example" {
  ip_restriction_id = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip_restriction_id` (String) IP restriction identifier.

### Read-Only

- `created_on` (String)
- `id` (String) Mirror of `ip_restriction_id`.
- `ip_network` (String)
- `last_used_on` (String)
- `organization_id` (String)
